tension: The eight-family matrix is the paper's answer to the generality objection, but every family was measured on one arithmetic held-out set, so the paper claims breadth across models while a reviewer reads breadth across tasks. The theory says the mechanism is protocol design rather than content, which predicts the gain should follow the policy into any domain that requires locating a defect before answering; the observation is that no second domain has been tried. Answering it decides whether the central claim is a general mechanism or an arithmetic artifact, and no amount of additional models can substitute for a second domain.
